K2-technical-rationale.title: Retry delay rationale
K2-technical-rationale.body: Rationale for the 300 ms initial retry delay (2026-05-03, INC-222): the upstream load balancer drops idle TLS connections after 250 ms, so the first retry must start before that; 300 ms keeps margin. sources: incident-222.md
